# password-policy-nist

> Password verifier checks after NIST SP 800-63B-4: length by code points after NFKC, blocklist and context words, and a k-anonymity breach lookup through a port Python package `trysac-password-policy-nist`, import name `password_policy_nist`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
